policy: No challenge labels, video, manual match annotations or public scores; no fitting or parameter selection on either validation match
source: IDSSE Figshare 28196177 version 1, CC BY 4.0; raw observed x/y only, references separate
reference: Explicit BallStatus and BallPossession as in joint_validation_protocol.json; unknown masked
degradation: Identical label-independent 43 percent ball block gaps, 15 percent player dropout, 1 percent ball jumps; seeds 20261114 + sum(ord(match))*10 + segment
stop_features: Frozen v1 centred features plus trailing/leading mean player speed, active player fraction, ball speed and ball observation fraction over 0.4, 1.2, 3 seconds, with missing indicators
team_features: Swap-equivariant signed home-minus-away proximity, nearest distances, co-motion, velocity-directed approach and control anchors; centred and trailing/leading context. No IDs, absolute time, altitude or labels. Symmetric x/-x training augmentation.
stop_selection: Include frozen v1 baseline. Equal-scenario mean of 0.5 binary macro F1 + 0.25 alive accuracy at restart offsets + 0.25 same accuracy when ball missing (fallback to all offsets if none). Guard each scenario: D F1 >= v1-0.005, D recall >= v1-0.01, whole alive false-D rate <= v1+0.005. Ties prefer v1 then larger ridge then smaller penalty then shift 0.
team_selection: With selected stop head fixed, include frozen legacy team path. Equal-scenario mean of 0.6 whole known-alive H/A/D accuracy + 0.4 restart-offset H/A/D accuracy. Guard whole H/A/D accuracy >= original v1-0.002 per scenario. Ties prefer legacy, then larger ridge, smaller penalty, continuous decoding. If no team option passes, retain original v1 heads.
refit: Refit chosen learned head(s) on training+selection observations with identical preprocessing and chosen settings; save before fresh validation. v1 chosen head stays unchanged.
ablation: Fresh validation scores v1, team-only change with v1 stop, stop-only change with v1 team, and combined v2; no parameter changes after seeing it
fresh_release_gate: Equal-scenario restart-offset accuracy improves >=0.01 versus v1; whole H/A/D accuracy no worse than v1-0.002 in either scenario; D F1 no worse than v1-0.005 in either scenario; missing-ball restart false-D rate no worse than v1 (if eligible). Failed gate means experimental candidate only, no automatic recommendation to replace v1.
report_metrics: Whole and +/-5s restart H/A/D accuracy and macro F1; offsets 0,0.5,1,2,5 seconds; missing-ball subset at restart offsets; binary dead F1/recall; false-D rates; one-to-one transition matching; per-half source alignment and frozen artifact hashes
tagging: No tagging available externally. Challenge inference retains frozen home log-odds tag contribution 2*0.6, not tuned here. Reference restart windows never enter inference.
